research_question: Does BB/Keltner compression release followed by the first causal retest-and-hold of the locked squeeze range produce positive frozen 30-second executable persistence with usable Stage-A supply?

rationale.corpus_clue: R037 VCE BB/KC release produced 27 direct entries, 20 official wins and +$0.71; completed meta-harvest repeatedly favors durable anchors plus delayed causal confirmation/retest over naked release.
source_logic: Open-source squeeze-channel logic: BB-inside-KC compression, lock squeeze high/low channel, breakout, retain channel as later support/resistance.
MQL5 breakout/retest logic: completed breakout, later retest touch, then directional confirming candle before entry.
Gold/XAUUSD public pullback logic: after a squeeze breakout, avoid chasing the initial break and seek the subsequent pullback/rebound.

source_references: MQL5 Article 19968: breakout, retest and confirmation sequence
GRP Gold Runner Pullback EA public logic summary
ForexFactory Gold discussion: squeeze followed by break/retest

frozen_common_semantics.squeeze: completed M5 BB upper < KC upper AND BB lower > KC lower
frozen_common_semantics.range_anchor: continuous squeeze segment high/low; lock segment range when squeeze ends
frozen_common_semantics.breakout: first later completed M5 close outside locked squeeze high/low; if a new squeeze begins before breakout, replace stale lock with new squeeze segment
frozen_common_semantics.event_invalidation: after breakout, event dies if a new M5 squeeze begins before retest confirmation or a completed bar closes beyond the opposite locked range boundary

17CM_M5_SQUEEZE_RANGE_RETEST.long_retest: first completed M5 bar after bullish breakout with low <= locked range high AND close > locked range high
17CM_M5_SQUEEZE_RANGE_RETEST.short_retest: first completed M5 bar after bearish breakout with high >= locked range low AND close < locked range low
17CM_M5_SQUEEZE_RANGE_RETEST.entry: first executable tick at/after confirmation-bar close

17CN_M1_SQUEEZE_RANGE_RETEST.long_retest: first completed M1 bar after bullish M5 breakout with low <= locked range high AND close > locked range high
17CN_M1_SQUEEZE_RANGE_RETEST.short_retest: first completed M1 bar after bearish M5 breakout with high >= locked range low AND close < locked range low
17CN_M1_SQUEEZE_RANGE_RETEST.entry: first executable tick at/after confirmation-bar close

gate.advance_if: any lane passes all three without post-result rescue
gate.retire_if: both lanes fail; no threshold/timeframe/session/side/exit rescue
